text: Hey buddy!
Thanks for coming by.
My headache's almost gone now.
Still can't believe Danny's dead, though.
zh: 不过我还是不敢相信丹尼死了。

text: I found your hammer.
You said, you owe me one for the hammer.
zh: 你说过，锤子的事你欠我一个人情。

text: Do you have something to sell?
Can you teach me how to forge weapons?
zh: 你能教我怎么锻造武器吗？

text: Craft me new equipment!
See you later.
Right!
Didn't forget about that.
You see, considering I'm the best and only smith in this camp.
zh: 你看，我可是这营地里最好的——也是唯一的铁匠。

text: Could give you some of my weapons?
zh: 要不送你几件我打的武器？

text: A weapon sounds good.
I am not interested in a weapon.
I'll need to think about that.
Haha, knew you'd like the sound of that, lad!
zh: 哈哈，就知道你会喜欢，小子！

text: Here's my latest work.
This long-sword. Made from the best steel around!
zh: 这把长剑。用这一带最好的钢打的！

text: I'll take it.
I have no use for a sword.
Put it to good use, won't ya.
What? No use for a sword?! You a pacifist or somethin'?
zh: 什么？用不上剑？！你是个和平主义者还是咋的？

text: This is the best steel you'll ever see.
zh: 这可是你这辈子能见到的最好的钢。

text: Well, your loss, lad.
zh: 行吧，那是你的损失，小子。

text: Then, here. 100 gold for ya.
Then, here. 50 gold for ya.
Here ya go.
Also...
Maybe you can use this ol' knife.
zh: 也许这把旧刀你用得上。

text: I made it for Danny, but he has no use for it now. Better you put it to good use than have it rust away here.
zh: 这是我给丹尼做的，但他现在用不上了。与其让它在这儿生锈，不如你拿去好好用。

text: See ya buddy!
I have some weapons lying around. Take a look.
zh: 我这儿放着些武器，看看吧。

text: Thanks lad. I really owe you one.
zh: 谢了小子。我真欠你一个人情。

text:
Hey buddy!
I'm not supposed to talk to you until you pay your fine to Balder.
zh:
嘿，伙计！
在你给巴尔德交清罚金之前，我不该跟你说话。

text:
Ha, Ha!
I don't have the time to teach you how to smith.
zh:
哈哈！
我可没时间教你打铁。

text: Balder would kick my ass if I forged even less than I already do.
zh: 我现在打的铁已经够少了，再少下去巴尔德非揍我不可。

text: But hear me out!
Bring me the #:blueprints:# and the needed #:materials:# for an item you want to have forged, and I will do the rest.
zh: 把你想锻造的物品的#:图纸:#和所需的#:材料:#拿来，剩下的交给我。

text: What do you think?
Where can I find blueprints?
Where can I find materials?
Can you also forge artefacts?
Sounds good!
Hmm... Let me think!
Some smiths sell these blueprints.
zh: 有些铁匠会卖这种图纸。

text: Also, if you're lucky, you could find blueprints in chests or so.
zh: 还有，运气好的话，你也能在宝箱之类的地方找到图纸。

text: Well, you can find ore in mines, obviously.
zh: 这个嘛，矿井里当然能挖到矿石。

text: I suppose some of the materials can be found at merchants as well.
zh: 我想有些材料在商人那儿也能买到。

text:
Great!
Let me know if you want to have something forged.
zh:
太好了！
想锻造什么就跟我说。

text: Bring me blueprints and I will forge everything for you.
zh: 把图纸拿来，我什么都能给你打出来。

text: Good job at the mine, lad!
zh: 矿井那事干得漂亮，小子！

text: This will give you strength again.
Congrats on joining our camp!

If you want, I can upgrade your new bandit armor.
For some gold, of course.
zh:
你要是愿意，我可以升级你的新强盗护甲。
当然，得收点金币。

text: No, my hands are too rough for that.
zh: 不行，我这双手太粗，干不了那种精细活。

text: You'll probably find someone in the capital who is able to craft these things.
zh: 在王都你多半能找到会做这些东西的人。

text: What's up?
